## Monday.com Board to Sheets Export
Weekly scheduled export of Monday.com board data to Google Sheets with email report.

**Setup:**
1. Replace YOUR_BOARD_ID in the HTTP Request body
2. Set Monday.com API token in HTTP Header Auth (Authorization: YOUR_TOKEN)
3. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail
4. Adjust schedule as needed (default: weekly)
